fields.why: Every VE CI excludes 0 and the summary claims 'additional protection', so A's CI-vs-fixed-value test is defensible; but the article never states a judgment against a fixed value, and A's evidence is the claim, not a CI judgment.
Follows procedure_classes: no named test, p-value or explicit CI-vs-null judgment appears; A's implicit CI-excludes-0 reading is defensible but unstated.
Inference is VE with 95% CIs (Tables 2-3); 'CIs and tests' holds only under A's implicit CI-vs-null reading, and waning is explicitly judged from point estimates without a test.

ICATT is a CDC VE platform the article itself calls 'the same ICATT network'; the brief puts VE networks under sentinel/network, and A's 'other' rests on registration and lab details that do not change that.

SVI enters only as a dichotomized model covariate and a program-targeting criterion; the article never names it as a determinant of the outcome. The brief does not say whether an area index used only for adjustment counts as a determinant.

brief_issues: Two recurring gaps: (1) whether a headline effect claim whose CIs all exclude the null counts as an unstated 'CI vs fixed value' test; suggest requiring explicit wording (e.g. 'CI did not include 0/1', 'significant'). (2) whether an SDOH index used only as a covariate goes in determinants_of_health; suggest no unless the article names it as an explanation.
